items.difficulty_reason: The argument models arbitrarily large finite-dimensional SDP solutions by finitely supported orthogonal-vector families with compatible minor operations. It proves equivalence of traditional local distributions and clause-vector decompositions by Gram-matrix alignment across connected components. A free-template construction and finite-color compactness then convert exact SDP feasibility into a global minion homomorphism, while evaluation of that homomorphism yields satisfying weak assignments.
